spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is a real photo of Four Four South Village with Taipei 101; image 4 is a real photo of the village houses' colorful doors and windows; image 5 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Golden dusk at Four Four South Village in Taipei: the old grey two-story village houses with colorful green, blue and red doors and window frames from images 3 and 4, Taipei 101 towering directly behind against a pink and gold sky. On the open paved square in front, the woman and the man sit back to back on the ground, laughing and leaning their weight against each other. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
